title: Raise conditional κ to 0.00389011528633 with a 320-factor single-band supplier
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ ≥ 0.00389011528633** for the complete paired integer multiplier. The exact gain over [#8031](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8031) is 0.00000000000273. The new result is 0.000000000000265 below the fixed word's directed raw BIT upper, 0.003890115286595.

The [#8030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8030) single-band machine admits a 320-factor binary profile at the exact trial 17519521755133/2^52. It keeps the paired literal operators, targets at least 15^320, paid slabs of at most 12^320 and complete band floor 2^44. Two directed engines prove strict surplus above 2^-43. The complete 24-bit binary debit, six restored ordinary stages and unchanged 10-bit positive debit yield ordinary BIT cap 0.003890115286380239 and the stated signed saving. Its largest binary carrier exponent is 114,688,000,000,000, about 2.61× smaller than #8031's carrier exponent. The older #8030 price-match profile has a smaller carrier and activation threshold at its earlier κ.

From the same raw upper and #8030's five-bit ordinary factor and four signed ticks, any matching installation at the #8031 rate requires H ≥ 1,692,047,377,327 with other losses forgiven. Its older price-match installation uses H = 1,568,000,000,000.

## Exact sources and overlap

- Canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. This branch reuses `0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026`, the same separate CI repair prerequisite as #8029 and #8031.
- [#8030 exact tape construction](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/6285dd829114705862e8d91facaedc1f31d3cfcb/research/single-band-native-carriers) at `6285dd829114705862e8d91facaedc1f31d3cfcb`. The offline replay authenticates all 91 files and applies five hash-checked module changes in a private copy. The original BIT and rational circuits are #8027 at `fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4`.
- [#8031 proof and replay](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/tree/745f2763cbe4eaa83cb0aa7d1dcebd4823668f08/research/p104-paired-source-complements) at `745f2763cbe4eaa83cb0aa7d1dcebd4823668f08` uses a different, source-complement compiler bound and a larger carrier. The new claim clears its raw upper minus the 869/H debit by about 2.6354e-12.

## Replay and scope

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-single-band-near-crossing
```

All eight CPython 3.12 cases passed locally. The checks cover both directed source prices, the full paid stage and activation proof, band loans and fringe, dense output, the exact BIT charts, the Gaussian grid and atlas, the physical rational caller and the signed product with the new profile. Controls reject an extra paid rank-one call, the fixed 288-factor sufficient certificate, the exact conservative 23-bit tariff test and equality at the signed ordinary gate. All five inherited premises remain explicit in the proof. The production-dimensional carriers and private tape reserves are covered by the written inequalities and finite operator controls. The new profile is checked by the directed program and written applicability proof. The inherited kernel package was not extended.

Ali Romman supplied the physical one-band construction, paired source and all-column operator evidence. Clear1nsight supplied the prior compiler work and this staged 320-factor extension, with predecessor proofs credited in the package. OpenAI Codex materially assisted the research, implementation and verification.

## Open next questions

Which legal change to the literal paid or productive histogram first clears 0.003890115286595? Check both signed source engines, then the changed operator and complete restoration and precision bill before advancing a new rate.
